text:
MERRODENE — Rosalind Tavner founded the Quillfeather Archive, according to people familiar with the matter, who cited the institution's original paperwork.

The Archive's founding was formally recorded on 14 March 1987. Desmond Okafor-Hale, Registrar of the Merrowdene Historical Society, certified the record, those people said.

Tavner began the collection with 2,300 donated manuscripts and pamphlets. The Quillfeather Charter of Establishment, signed by Tavner, was filed with the Merrowdene Civic Records Office and sets out her role as founder.

The people familiar with the matter said the charter remains the Archive's governing founding document. Neither the Archive nor the Historical Society issued a public statement.

Meridian Brief will update this item as further details emerge.
